listing.name: WET (WET Recomp)
listing.summary: Attach an independently permitted, already prepared WET Windows player through wet.exe and its actual imported game directory. Preserve the existing SDK-selected data roots; exact original revision and default persistence placement remain unverified.

steps.title: Prepare your original upstream
steps.instruction: Use a complete permitted WET player/components and your own Xbox 360 WET original. Finish ADD ISO/import and settings in the upstream launcher before registration. The retained importer establishes a prepared game/default.xex route, but no exact supported region/media/revision or default.xex digest is established here. Do not infer that every WET revision works. No original, importer, compiler, helper or game is executed here.

steps.title: Keep the actual official native package
steps.instruction: The inspected v0.6.0 Windows ZIP includes AMD64 wet.exe, runtime DLLs and extract-xiso.exe; the managed WPF WetLauncher.exe has a different PE machine classification and is not the native game. Source-build instructions do not turn this complete native package into a mandatory end-user compile. Keep the whole matching package and notices, with separately prepared game data.

steps.title: Attach the normal native executable
steps.instruction: Select wet.exe, use the complete package directory as working directory and set --game_data_root="absolute actual prepared game directory". Review the exact intent and request Play separately. This matches the launcher’s native game-data argument; the native app enters the linked game and otherwise searches executable-folder/game then working-directory/game. Do not select the importer or detached WPF launcher. Launcher display/controller arguments do not automatically transfer to direct launch; finish and retain native settings, using upstream F3 settings where appropriate.

steps.title: Preserve the actual existing data layout
steps.instruction: Keep the full original/imported game directory, native configuration and logs, launcher preferences, saves/profiles/cache and every existing SDK-selected or explicitly configured external data root. This investigation does not establish the SDK’s exact default Windows persistence directory: identify and retain the existing active roots from your prepared installation and logs before replacement; do not assume all saves are beside wet.exe or create an empty substitute. Retain existing explicit data-root arguments when applicable. No move, conversion, restore or deletion is performed.

steps.title: Preserve qualification and maintenance boundaries
steps.instruction: Keep project MIT and SDK/Xenia/component notices; original game permissions remain separate. The selected source still registers missing guest-function return stubs, so fixes and native packaging do not establish whole-campaign completeness. Upstream launcher updates can replace/restart programs; finish them outside Portcove, quit the actual game and review/relink changed bytes. Exact original fingerprint, default data placement and native/save acceptance remain unfinished on the owner. No Supported or managed lifecycle outcome is asserted.

warnings: Exact original revision and default SDK save-root placement remain unknown. Preserve the actual existing prepared installation and all active data roots; direct wet.exe launch does not inherit every launcher option.
